full_judgment: 5. Mr. Sultan Ahmad, learned Advocate for the petitioner, submits that the learned Subordinate Judge as well as the High Court Division erred in law in not considering that rejection of the plaint being a decree, an appeal was available to the plaintiff and that the application under section 151 CPC did not lie.
